gradient_colonnade.name: Gradient colonnade / five outlines, value up
gradient_colonnade.description: The five classical column outlines (Vessel, Reed, Bell, Spindle, Cairn) in a row, each one body coloured by height: near black at the foot, its full hue at the top. Same height, sides and divisions for all five, so the outline and the hue are what differ. Stands on the pillar colour floor of the tower.
